references.text: The original instruction to make poles of acacia wood and insert them into the rings on the sides of the altar to carry it.
A similar construction with poles in rings for carrying the ark of the covenant, showing the same carrying system used for holy objects.
The incense altar also had rings and poles for carrying it, the same carrying system as the bronze altar.
The description of how the poles were inserted into the rings on the ark to carry it, a parallel construction.
The context of this verse - the construction of the bronze altar which was hollow and made of boards.
The Levites' responsibility for carrying the altar, which required using the poles mentioned in this verse.
Thematic parallel: The same construction principle (poles through rings) for transporting holy furniture.
